parsed.quote: An unchanged field on a pivot date may be represented by the literal is_null. ... coalesce(story_points,'is_null') story_points ... The contract says "Unchanged fields on that date remain NULL; fields changed to true NULL appear as ‘is_null’". ... Coalescing after the pivot erases the distinction between no update and an explicit null update
